### Checklist

<!-- Please make sure you check all these items before submitting your bug report. -->

- [ ] The bug is reproducible against the latest release and/or `master`.
- [x] There are no similar issues or pull requests to fix it yet.

### Describe the bug

<!-- A clear and concise description of what the bug is. -->
I'm using set_cookie function to set cookie for response, however when I test connection with python library requests, it doesn't set the cookie.

### To reproduce

<!-- Provide a *minimal* example with steps to reproduce the bug locally.

NOTE: try to keep any external dependencies *at an absolute minimum*
(middleware, servers, proxies, certificates...).
In other words, remove anything that doesn't make the bug go away.
-->
My Server code for api in FastAPI:
```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI, Response
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

router = APIRouter()
@router.post(
    "/activate-login-link",
    responses={
        status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT: {
            "description": "Successful authorization.",
        },
    },
)
async def activate_login_link():
    response = Response(status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
    response.set_cookie(key="AUTH_TOKEN", value="some-cookie", domain="localhost", path="/", max_age=43200, expires=43200)
    return response

app = FastAPI(title="Async FastAPI")

origins = [
    "http://localhost:3000", "*"
]

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=origins,
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(router)
```

My Client code for testing:
```python
import requests as rs
s = rs.Session()
login_code = s.post('http://localhost:8000/api/v1/get-login-code', json={'email': 'rufusnufus@gmail.com'}).json()
response = s.post('http://localhost:8000/api/v1/activate-login-link')
print(response.headers)
print(response.cookies.get_dict())
```

### Expected behavior

<!-- A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen. -->
Client Response is the following:
```bash
{'date': 'Tue, 23 Nov 2021 14:36:24 GMT', 'server': 'uvicorn', 'set-cookie': 'AUTH_TOKEN=some-cookie; Domain=localhost; expires=Wed, 24 Nov 2021 02:36:24 GMT; Max-Age=43200; Path=/; SameSite=lax'}
{'AUTH_TOKEN': 'some-cookie'}
```

### Actual behavior

<!-- A clear and concise description of what actually happens. -->

Client Response is the following:
```bash
{'date': 'Tue, 23 Nov 2021 14:36:24 GMT', 'server': 'uvicorn', 'set-cookie': 'AUTH_TOKEN=some-cookie; Domain=localhost; expires=Wed, 24 Nov 2021 02:36:24 GMT; Max-Age=43200; Path=/; SameSite=lax'}
{}
```

### Debugging material

<!-- Any tracebacks, screenshots, etc. that can help understanding the problem.

NOTE:
- Please list tracebacks in full (don't truncate them).
- Consider using `<details>` to make tracebacks/logs collapsible if they're very large (see https://gist.github.com/ericclemmons/b146fe5da72ca1f706b2ef72a20ac39d).
-->

### Environment

- OS: macOS
- Python version: 3.7.12
- Starlette version: 0.16.0
- FastAPI version: 0.70.0
- requests version: 2.26.0

### Additional context

<!-- Any additional information that can help understanding the problem.

Eg. linked issues, or a description of what you were trying to achieve. -->
